title: Q-YEAR-self-coder: the system's own coder ships a release with no outside session
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** UNATTENDED-365 register, dependency `self-coder` is open
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation unattended --probe self-coder
**Status:** closed

Raise the executor's kept rate: use the measured free models (gpt-oss-120b as author, glm-4.7-flash and mistral-small as reviewers of other families), never approve with every reviewer skipped, and record the origin on each deploy so k_self counts. Closed when ops/criticality.jsonl shows self_deploys > 0.
When it holds, set the dependency's status to closed in doctrine/unattended.json with the evidence and a probe that proves it.

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 23.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-22T07:11:04Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: self-coder: closed
